mentions.name: Multi-source health data aggregator
mentions.description: This Go application ingests health data from multiple sources at a wider scale: annual preventive-care bloodwork, InBody measurements including grip strength, regional air quality, Apple Watch data (steps, sleep, resting heart rate), and a planned nutrition/allergy or minerals/vitamins screen. It is intended to surface trends and apply AI to correlate seemingly unrelated data layers, such as how sleep quality is affected by above-average daily steps combined with poor air quality like wildfires or pollen season. The first import use case, Apple Watch data, is nearly finished.
mentions.problem: Health data is spread across disconnected sources, making it hard to see trends and understand how factors like activity level and air quality affect sleep quality.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've built a Go application to ingest those data sources and currently finishing my first import use case - Apple Watch data.

evidence.value: I've built a Go application to ingest those data sources and currently finishing my first import use case - Apple Watch data.
